text:
Noah: quick check — brought up reranker-v2 (384d dense) across us-west / eu-west / ap-south. Ran synthetic sweep for batch=1,8,64 on GPU fp16 and CPU int8 fallback. sharing p50/p95 + qps below, looking for kernel routing suggestions.

Samantha: can you paste the p50/p95 and qps numbers? especially p95 for us-west and ap-south.

Noah: pasted raw run (single-GPU node runs, cold start cleared):
```
region   backend  batch  qps   p50(ms)  p95(ms)
us-west  GPU_fp16   1    420    14       88
us-west  GPU_fp16   8   3200     9       62
us-west  GPU_fp16  64  21000     7       45
EU-west  GPU_fp16   1    380    16      120
EU-west  GPU_fp16   8   2800    10       70
AP-south GPU_fp16   1    200    22      260  <-- large p95
AP-south GPU_fp16  64  10000    10      140
us-west  CPU_int8    1     35   120      420
us-west  CPU_int8    8    260    80      340
```
Noah: kernel: default fused-attn + cuBLAS matmul path on GPU. CPU uses quant-int8 kernels (x86-avx2 path).

Raj: ap-south looks suspect — p95=260ms on batch=1 suggests PCIe/thermal or NUMA. Did you pin processes and set GPU affinity? what driver and card model?

Noah: card is A10G (ap-south cluster nodes), driver 535.49. process pinned to core mask 0xFF, but I didn't check NUMA binding explicitly.

Henry: for 384-dim rerank at small batches we saw tiled-mha kernel beat fused-attn for p95 on some hw. Try tiled-mha for batch=1 and keep fused for batch>=8. hybrid kernel routing tends to help tail latency.

Noah: will flip to tiled-mha for batch=1 in eu-west/ap-south. what flag?

Henry: config snippet:
```yaml
model_runtime:
  kernel_policy:
    - condition: batch==1
      kernel: tiled-mha
    - condition: batch>1
      kernel: fused-attn
```

Maria: FYI ap-south autoscaler history shows some nodes hitting sustained lower GPU clocks under load — might be cloud host thermal profile. also check PCIe gen / slot mapping. single-threaded CPU fallback sometimes outruns multi-threaded on noisy hosts.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: reranker-v2 canary -> eu-west (1 node) at 2026-03-19T14:12:00Z

Noah: swapped to tiled-mha for batch=1 on eu-west + ap-south canary, quick rerun (cold done):
```
EU-west  GPU_fp16  batch=1  qps=400  p50=12  p95=74
AP-south GPU_fp16  batch=1  qps=260  p50=16  p95=112  <-- big improvement but still > target
```

Samantha: much better in eu-west. ap-south improved a lot — still above SLO. try: 1) confirm PCIe gen, 2) run with single-threaded worker, 3) try different driver (535.x vs 538.x) if possible.

Noah: next steps: run dim sweep [256,384,512] with hybrid kernel policy across regions, collect perf traces (+tracer id: rerank-210234). I'll open bench PR and tag infra.

Raj: :thumbsup: add perf traces, and include per-token time breakdown (kv, attn, softmax). might expose where tail is.

Noah: thanks — tagging @Maria for PCIe/host checks and @Henry for kernel follow-ups. I'll post results in this thread when done. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
